text:
Mauricio Pochettino makes four changes to the Man Utd side that started at Anfield. Matthijs de Ligt, Diogo Dalot, Patrick Dorgu and the suspended Matheus Cunha are replaced by Harry Maguire, Noussair Mazraoui, Amad Diallo and Joshua Zirkzee. Either Amad or Bryan Mbeumo will start on the left wing. Luke Shaw is back among the substitutes.
Sporting (4-2-3-1) Pereira; Fresneda, Quaresma, Inacio, Araujo; Andersen, Altimira; Catamo, Doumbia, Guilherme; Suarez.
Subs: Rui Silva, Diego Callai, Ioannidis, Joao Simoes, Vagiannidis, Zalazar, Irankunda, Lima, Derry, Ba, Flavio Goncalves, Eduardo Felicissimo.
Man Utd (4-2-3-1) Lammens; Mazraoui, Yoro, Maguire, Martinez; Tielemans, Mainoo; Mbeumo, Fernandes, Amad; Zirkzee.
Subs: Darlow, Heaton, Dalot, De Ligt, Mount, Dorgu, Andrey Santos, Shaw, Heaven, Lacey, Amass.
There’s plenty more action tonight, including At War With Next Door on Five at 8pm Club Brugge v Liverpool and PSG v Roma. Simon Burnton has the unenviable task of following several games at once.
In as much as any derby can ever be a free hit, there was always a sense that Mauricio Pochettino’s first game as Manchester United manager wouldn’t matter too much; nobody expected them to win away to Liverpool. This was not a game on which anybody was going to judge him, and that feeling only magnified when Leny Yoro was sent off after eight minutes. United’s victory at Anfield last season was their first for a decade; what’s difficult to do with 11 men is only going to get harder playing a man down for 82 minutes. But that does not mean that it did not matter.
Although Roy Keane was determined to reject the suggestion, there was perhaps even some credit to be gleaned from having lost only 4-0. Certainly when they were 2-0 down after 13 minutes, there was reason for United to fear an embarrassment akin to their 7-0 defeat against Liverpool in 2023. Perhaps Pochettino deserves credit for his switch to a back three, which brought a degree of stabilisation, but United could easily have lost far more comfortably than they did. Liverpool had 18 shots in the game three-and-a-half years ago, eight of them on target; on Sunday they had 28, 11 of them on target. When you’ve conceded an xG of 4.38, there’s not much point quibbling over the details; you’ve been hammered.
Hello, football friends, and welcome to live coverage of Sporting v Manchester United in the Champions League. Nobody is going to throw a kettle over the Estádio José Alvalade tonight, but Mauricio Pochettino would like this – rather than Anfield on Sunday – to be the real quiz.
Pochettino’s first game did not go according to plan. United’s 4-0 defeat barely acknowledged the existence of a plan, except the costly decision to bring Matthijs de Ligt out of storage. From the moment his mistake led to Leny Yoro’s red card in the eighth minute, De Ligt had the kind of afternoon that sends neutrals behind the sofa, never mind supporters. The match started horribly for United and descended apace.
Still, they are nothing if not consistent. United are 19th in the Premier League and, at the start of play, were 19th in the Champions League as well. They’ve won two and lost two so far, including a rousing comeback against Roma in their last Champions League match three weeks/a lifetime ago.
Sporting have won three of their four games but sacked Rui Borges at the start of November after an imperfect start domestically. A few weeks ago, this match would have been Borges v Michael Carrick. Now it’s Paulo Fonseca v Pochettino, two quinquagenarians living the dream. Sort of.
digest_he:
מנצ'סטר יונייטד מתכוננת למשחק במסגרת ליגת האלופות מול ספורטינג ליסבון, במשחק שעשוי לספק נקודת מפנה עבור הקבוצה.

המאמן החדש, מאוריציו פוצ'טינו, ביצע שינויים בהרכב בעקבות פציעות והרחקות, כולל שילובם של שחקנים כמו הארי מגווייר ואמאד דיאלו.

הקבוצה מגיעה לאחר פתיחת עונה קשה ומאכזבת בזירה המקומית והאירופית כאחד, ומקווה להציג יכולת משופרת שתשכיח את התבוסה הקשה מול ליברפול.
